evidence: Department of Energy (DOE) Fusion Energy Sciences Program

evidence: China National Space Administration (CNSA) Lunar and Mars missions
ITER commitment and national fusion programs (e.g., HL-2M)

ITER commitment and JT-60SA fusion research

evidence: STEP (Spherical Tokamak for Energy Production) program
